## Merge metadata
I want to add the PRESTOID, case-control and gender to the sample sheet (target), finally I need a master table to use in downstream analysis. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Working dir

```{r}
results.dir.pheno <- file.path("../../results/00_data_wrangling/")
dir.create(results.dir.pheno, recursive = TRUE)
```


```{r message=FALSE}
# sample sheet
df_sheet = readr::read_csv(
  "../../data/array_raw_data/idats/MET2020-242-014.csv",
  skip=8
  )%>%
  mutate(
    sampleID =  dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Name == "F16-ii" ~ "F16",
      Sample_Name == "X15-II" ~ "X15",
      Sample_Name == "X7-ii" ~ "X7",
      .default = Sample_Name
      )
 )%>%
  dplyr::select(-one_of(c("Gender", "Pool_ID")))

# PRESTO metadata
cols.keep <- c(
  "PRESTO_ID","MS_nr","Group_detailed","Group_simple","Group_numeric", "GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq",
"SEO_COPD_Y_or_N","COPD_Y_or_N","Sample_date","Gender","Gender_binary","Age","Age_category","Height","Weight","BMI","Smoking_status","Pack_years","Years_since_smoking_cessation","FEV1_FVC_ratio_best","FEV1_percent_of_predicted_best"
)

df_presto = readr::read_csv(
  "../../docs/no_col_remarks_PRESTO_proteogenomics_full_data_set_v14.csv"
  )%>%
  dplyr::select(
    all_of(cols.keep)
    )

# Add PPRESTO col to df_sheet
df_target = df_sheet %>%
  left_join(
    df_presto, by = c("sampleID"= "MS_nr")# IDK what is MS_nr(Ask Niek)
    )

df_target
```

## Add Isolation day for batch correction

```{r}
df = readr::read_csv(
  "../../docs/iso_day.csv"
  )%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_Nr, Isolation_day)


df_target2 = df_target %>%
  left_join(
    df, by = c("sampleID"= "Sample_Nr")# IDK what is MS_nr(Ask Niek)
    )%>%
  mutate(
    Isolation_day = ifelse(is.na(Isolation_day), "missing_date", Isolation_day)
    )%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Sample_Group))

# Rename samples
rownames(df_target2) <- paste0(df_target2$Sentrix_ID ,"_", df_target2$Sentrix_Position)
df_target2
```
```{r}
df_target3 <- df_target2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    Gender = as.factor(Gender),
    Smoking_status = as.factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        Smoking_status == 0 ~ "ES",
        Smoking_status == 1 ~ "CS",
        Smoking_status == 2 ~ "NS",
        Smoking_status == NA ~ "ALFA",
      )),
    COPD_Y_or_N = as.factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
      COPD_Y_or_N == 0 ~ "Control",
      COPD_Y_or_N == 1 ~ "COPD"
    )),
    SEO_COPD_Y_or_N = as.factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
      SEO_COPD_Y_or_N == 0 ~ "Control",
      SEO_COPD_Y_or_N ==1 ~ "SEO_COPD",
      TRUE ~ as.character(SEO_COPD_Y_or_N)
  ))
)
df_target3
```
# Add cell proportions
Cell-type proportions estimated with MuSiC from the PRESTO bulk RNA-seq
(`cell_proportions/music2/run_music2_4.R`, HLCA parenchyma reference, gene-length
corrected bulk; plain MuSiC estimates, not MuSiC2). See the vault note
"Cell-type deconvolution MuSiC2 PRESTO" for the cell-type choices and checks.

New columns are prefixed `MuSiC_` (e.g. `MuSiC_AT1`, `MuSiC_Alveolar_macrophages`) so they
never clash with the metadata columns or with the old CIBERSORTx columns
(`Fibroblast.lineage`, `AT2`, ...) in `pheno.data_SEOvsCtrl_ES.csv`.

```{r}
# Which MuSiC run to use (folder in cell_proportions/music2/results/)
MUSIC_RUN <- "music2_v7_split_lymphoid"   # or "music2_v6_custom_celltypes"

music.prop <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path("../../cell_proportions/music2/results", MUSIC_RUN, "PRESTO_music2_proportions.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

df_cp <- music.prop |>
  dplyr::filter(method == "MuSiC") |>                                   # one row per RNA sample
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("method", "PRESTO_ID", "Group_simple", "Group_detailed"))) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("MuSiC_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", .x)), -GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_cp$GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq))

pheno.data <- df_target3 %>%
  left_join(df_cp, by = "GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq", na_matches = "never")
stopifnot(nrow(pheno.data) == nrow(df_target3))   # join must not add or drop rows

dim(pheno.data)
colSums(!is.na(pheno.data[, grep("^MuSiC_", names(pheno.data))]))   # samples with proportions
```

```{r}
meta.data = file.path(results.dir.pheno, "main_table_cell_proportions_MUSIC.csv")
write_csv(
  pheno.data, 
  file = meta.data
  )
```
